text:
tao: Pushed vellichor-v0.9 (int8) into a canary yesterday. Quick smoke shows JA/ZH translation BLEU down ~4.2 pts vs our fp16 baseline on news-multilang. Also noticed Arabic outputs sometimes flip bracket orientation (closing vs opening) around embedded Latin. Anyone seen this?

mia: Saw something odd on mixed-script samples this morning. Can you paste a minimal repro and the eval command? pinging @sanjay for tokenizer checks.

tao: Minimal example below (input -> model output). Repro command after.

Input (news snippet):
```
日本の(経済)報告は、、最新のデータを示しています。
```
vellichor-v0.9 int8 output:
```
日本の(経済)報告は、最新のデータを示しています。
```
Notice extra tokenization split on the closing paren and an extra halfwidth comma.

Arabic sample (input):
```
تقرير عن (السوق) يناير 2026.
```
Output: closing/opening bracket flipped in place — e.g. returned `)السوق(` instead of `(السوق)` in a couple of cases.

Repro: `./eval_harness --model vellichor-v0.9 --qconfig int8 --dataset news-multilang --langs ja,zh,ar --commit=abc123 --seed=42 --samples=5000`

sanjay: I dumped token ids for the JA example. Diff shows an extra subtoken before the closing fullwidth paren for the int8 run vs fp16. Likely a subtoken boundary shift. Could be tokenizer change, or logits around the boundary moved because of quant rounding. I'll paste a short token-id diff: `... 5021 1187 5022` -> `... 5021 99 1187 5022` (extra 99 token inserted).

ollie: Also saw embedding-similarity drift for punctuation tokens when comparing int8 vs fp16 (cosine down ~0.12 for U+FF09 fullwidth right paren). Could be mapping shift in tokenmap or rounding noise in kernel.

tao: CI canary logs show no preprocessing changes on our side; tokenizer vocab same as baseline. This aligns with quantized kernel producing slightly different top-k at boundary.

ci-bot: Canary deploy succeeded at 2026-03-23T14:12:03Z. Throughput: 1.1x baseline, tail latency within SLO.

mia: Proposed triage: 1) run tokenization diffs across failing samples and attach sample set to forensic repo 2) bisect runtime/kernel commits touching softmax / argmax / fused ops 3) run detok with stricter NFKC/NFC normalization 4) test with KV cache disabled to isolate caching effects.

sanjay: I added token-level diffs for 50 failing JA/AR samples into the eval artifact. For Arabic, bracket flips correspond to token id reordering where mirrored punctuation becomes split from the word and the bidi reordering step in detok picks the wrong visual order.

ollie: Starting a bisect on the quant kernels now. Targeting the fused-softmax reorder PR first (PR #789). ETA ~30m.

tao: If fusion is the culprit, a short-term mitigation could be to preserve fp32 softmax for tokens in our punctuation whitelist or fall back to unfused kernel for qconfig=int8. Need to assess perf impact.

mia: Also let's add deterministic detok assertions to the eval suite: bracket parity checks for Arabic, parity + spacing invariants for CJK punctuation. Add a test that runs detok under both NFKC and NFC and fails if outputs diverge in bracket orientation.

ci-bot: Action created: ML-452 (hotfix to disable fusion for punctuation-sensitive kernels), ML-453 (detok/locale test), ML-454 (forensic sample ingest).

ollie: Bisect result: commit abc234 (kernel fused-softmax reorder) is the first bad commit. Re-running with fusion disabled returns BLEU to within 0.3 pts of baseline and fixes the bracket orientation in the Arabic sample. Patch diff attached in the bisect artifact.

tao: Great find. Mia, want to own the hotfix PR? We should also add a regression test in the quant smoke matrix to run the punctuation-sensitive sample set.

mia: I can own the PR. I'll also add the detok assertions to the smoke job.

sanjay: I'll enrich the eval report with token-id traces and add the failing examples to the forensic dataset so we won't lose them.

tao: Rolling canary back to previous image for traffic > 0.3 while PR lands. Leaving the thread open until PR merge. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ollie: Confirmed rollback completed at 2026-03-23T14:58:45Z. Will follow up with perf numbers after PR merge.

ci-bot: PR created: hotfix/disable-fusion-punct-ml-452 (#1201). CI: pending.

mia: Will open the test PR in the next hour.

sanjay: Uploaded token-diff artifacts and a short notebook to reproduce id splits locally. Link: https://forensic.internal/ML-453/artifacts

tao: Closing loop once hotfix merged. Thanks everyone.
